sites.role: Single delivery unit. Meridian models authority by site; FitAdapt has one team, so one site (see pmo/meridian/dogfood-log.md, DF-12).

projects.name: Phase 0 — Foundation
projects.desc: M00 platform, M17 privacy baseline, M20 legal framework. Exit: architecture review and Gate 0 (docs/governance/03, §6).

projects.name: Phase 1 — Safe MVP
projects.desc: A single user can onboard, get assessed, follow a periodized home/gym program offline and see progress. Exit: council sign-off on screening wording, engine coefficients and pain model; internal alpha with the six personas.

projects.name: Phase 2 — Differentiation
projects.desc: Fair Pair, nutrition with guardrails, AI coach, wearables. Exit: dietitian and physician review M10 guardrails and M11 eval results; closed beta of Fair Pair.

projects.name: Phase 3 — Business & scale
projects.desc: Engagement loops, subscriptions, analytics/CMS, coach portal. Exit: counsel reviews pricing, payment flows, claims and consent texts.

projects.name: Phase 4 — Innovation & launch
projects.desc: Voice and camera execution, full privacy/security programme with pen-test, store launch. Exit: launch:check green including legal gates, pen-test findings closed, council and counsel sign-off for every launch jurisdiction.

projects.name: Governance — Gate 0, counsel & Expert Advisory Council
projects.desc: Founder protections (Gate 0), counsel per launch market, and the real advisory board required by decision C10. Owns every sign-off of a validated:false item.

projects.name: Meridian dogfooding & contribution
projects.desc: FitAdapt is run on Meridian. Friction found in daily use is logged, triaged weekly and contributed back to github.com/mliad313sn/Meridian (docs/governance/05-dogfooding-loop.md).

raid.title: Personal injury following a prescription or partner challenge
raid.detail: Controls: S1–S7, L3, L4, conservative defaults, expert-validated content, L11 audit trail, insurance, terms with lawful limitation clauses. Modules M01–M05, M09, M20.

raid.title: Features or copy imply a medical purpose (medical-device rules)
raid.detail: L1 claims linter, no diagnosis, no condition-specific programs, regulatory review of screening, pain and nutrition copy. Modules M05, M10, M11, M20.

raid.title: Nutrition or rehab guidance treated as unlicensed professional practice
raid.detail: General guidance only, no medical nutrition therapy or rehab plans, referral to professionals, coach credential checks. Modules M05, M10, M15.

raid.title: Unlawful health-data processing, breach, missing filings or transfers
raid.detail: M17 + L9, DPIA, consent records, encryption, authority filings, transfer mechanisms, breach runbook. Modules M17, M12, M04.

raid.title: Missing AI disclosure or harmful AI advice
raid.detail: L5 disclosure, S6 tool-only changes, safety evals at 100%, grounded retrieval, human-reviewed red-team set. Modules M11, M14.

raid.title: Hard-to-cancel subscriptions, unclear prices, withdrawal rights ignored
raid.detail: L8, store-managed billing, cancellation parity test, trial reminders, withdrawal-waiver capture. Module M16.

raid.title: Unsubstantiated claims, fake reviews or unconsented before/after photos
raid.detail: L1, L8, L12, substantiation file for every marketing claim, testimonial consent records. Modules M19, M20.

raid.title: Unlicensed media, questionnaire wording, fonts, datasets or code
raid.detail: L6 asset register, SBOM, OSS licence allowlist in CI, licence check before verbatim use (e.g. PAR-Q+). Modules M06, M10, M20.

raid.title: Product or feature names infringe an existing mark
raid.detail: L7 clearance before public use; 'FitAdapt' stays a codename; two fallback names. Modules M19, M20.

raid.title: A coach on the platform gives harmful advice
raid.detail: L10 coach agreement with indemnity, credential verification, engine caps coaches cannot lift, reporting channel. Module M15.

raid.title: Harassment or unlawful user-generated content
raid.detail: Report/block, moderation queue, notice-and-action procedure, community guidelines. Module M13.

raid.title: Under-age users, or minors exposed to calorie restriction
raid.detail: Age gate at 16 (higher where local law requires), no targeting of minors, deficit features off under 18. Modules M01, M10.

raid.title: Non-compliance with accessibility law (EAA)
raid.detail: WCAG 2.2 AA design system and audits. Modules M00, M19.

raid.title: Store removal over health-data, payments or account-deletion rules
raid.detail: Store compliance checklists, in-app account deletion, accurate privacy labels. Modules M16, M17, M19.

raid.title: Founder personal exposure or employer IP conflict
raid.detail: C12: company structure, IP assignments, employment-contract check, insurance. Gate 0.

raid.title: Cross-border VAT on digital services
raid.detail: Stores as merchant of record for in-app sales; merchant-of-record provider for web checkout. Module M16.

raid.title: Engine coefficients or thresholds inaccurate
raid.detail: Every value carries source + validated flag; remote-config versioning with rollback (M18); council sign-off before public launch (C10).

raid.title: Scope creep across 21 modules
raid.detail: Phase gates; each /goal has a turn cap and a status file; later modules can slip without blocking the MVP. Change requests go through Meridian change control.

raid.title: LLM running cost exceeds plan
raid.detail: Tier-based rate limits, routing to smaller models, caching, offline deterministic fallback.

raid.title: Poor experience on low connectivity and low-end devices
raid.detail: Offline-first architecture, performance budgets, downloadable media packs.

raid.title: Product Owner not yet named
raid.detail: The appointment instrument is drafted (docs/governance/01). Until it is signed the founder acts as interim Product Owner.

raid.title: All eleven council seats are open
raid.detail: No validated:false item can be signed off until the seats are filled. Recruitment brief: docs/governance/03, §4.

raid.title: The v2.1 committee was a simulated panel
raid.detail: Its findings are hypotheses. Every item marked validated:false needs a real, qualified council member's signature before public launch (C10).

raid.title: Timings are indicative and assume a small team driving Claude Code /goal runs
raid.detail: Re-plan and re-baseline after Phase 0, using the turn counts and status files of M00, M17 and M20.

raid.title: Budget is not yet baselined
raid.detail: Budgets in this book are zero on purpose. The sponsor sets them at Gate 0; until then earned value is not meaningful.

raid.title: Gate 0 must clear before Phase 1 starts (GOALS.md)
raid.detail: Company, IP, employment check, counsel, name clearance started, insurance quotes, advisory-board agreements drafted.

raid.title: Council seated before the Gate 1 review
raid.detail: Seats A1–A5 at minimum must be filled and under agreement by week 12 to review screening wording, coefficients and pain model.

raid.title: Meridian's three operational blockers are ours to close
raid.detail: A tested backup, a second instance and a written security policy (Meridian SECURITY.md). Closed by activity D02.
